plan: Staying in at this price is not profitable as my value equals the current price. Any further increase will lead to a loss. It's better to drop out now to avoid negative earnings.

My value is $18, equal to the current price. Staying in beyond this price will result in a loss if I win, as my profit would be negative ($18 - $18.5 = -$0.5). It's rational to drop out now to avoid a loss.
My value for the prize is $21, and the current price is $20.5. If I stay in and win at $21, my profit will be $0. Staying in at $21.0 is not profitable, so I will drop out.
